strings.name: Brian Chesky
strings.summary: Trained in industrial design, Chesky co-founded Airbnb with Joe Gebbia and Nathan Blecharczyk, connecting spare homes with travel accommodation demand. He announced pandemic layoffs and led the company through its IPO, then expanded experiences, services and hotels. Short-term rentals’ effects on housing and communities remain contested; restrictions in cities including New York have changed platform operations.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founded Airbnb and popularized online short-term rentals, changing travel accommodation supply and global debate about platform-economy regulation.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: BFA in industrial design, Rhode Island School of Design (2004).
strings.highlights.h1.title: Accommodation marketplace
strings.highlights.h1.text: Developed Airbnb with co-founders and teams to connect hosts and travelers.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Beyond accommodation
strings.highlights.h2.text: Advanced experiences and services, adding boutique-hotel offerings in 2026.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Expands travel offerings
strings.timeline.t1.text: Airbnb announced expanded services, boutique hotels and selected AI features.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Introduces services and redesigned experiences
strings.timeline.t2.text: The company launched Airbnb Services and a redesigned Airbnb Experiences offering.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Faces New York rental restrictions
strings.timeline.t3.text: After new city rules took effect, Airbnb stopped accepting some short-term reservations.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Nasdaq IPO
strings.timeline.t4.text: Airbnb completed its IPO and began public trading.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Announces pandemic layoffs
strings.timeline.t5.text: Chesky informed employees that about one-quarter of staff would leave amid the pandemic shock.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Co-founds Airbnb
strings.timeline.t6.text: Built the accommodation-booking enterprise with Gebbia and Blecharczyk.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Welcomes first paying guests
strings.timeline.t7.text: Hosted guests with Gebbia in their San Francisco home, beginning the business.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Earns industrial-design degree
strings.timeline.t8.text: Graduated from RISD, where he had met Gebbia.
